items.title: When Jamey Garner wants to move, the Hohner Rocket keeps up. 🚀
items.excerpt: When Jamey Garner wants to move, the Hohner Rocket keeps up. 🚀 Built for speed, comfort, and response, the Rocket is Jamey's go-to when it's time to "chicken pick" and let the notes fly. Hear more from Jamey in his full HOHNER Artist Spotlight on YouTube at the link in bio! #Hoh…
